---
title: "Interactive network"
subtitle: "The trade graph as a live, weighted Louvain community view"
---

Same Louvain partition as [03 · Communities](notebooks/03_communities.ipynb), as a
force-directed graph.

**Read.** Colour = community (continental core / Nordic-Baltic / extra-European partners).
Size ∝ total trade strength. Edge width ∝ summed bilateral value.

**Use.** Hover for figures, drag to pull a bloc apart, scroll to zoom; on-canvas buttons
freeze, refit, or toggle labels. Layout seeded from `config.RANDOM_SEED`.


::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Why the blocs are not the EU

The partition splits the EU-27 across all three communities, places non-members
Switzerland and Norway inside EU clusters, and sends EU-member Ireland into the US-led
bloc. The reasoning is in [03 · Communities](notebooks/03_communities.ipynb).
:::
